data.name: Jahida
data.gender_notes: Jahida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jahida is derived from the Arabic word 'hida' which means 'to guide' or 'to lead'. The name Jahida carries the meaning “Guide, Leader” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jahida usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Jahida signifies one who guides others towards righteousness and truth.
data.etymology: Jahida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jahida total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_urdu.name: جاہدہ

in_urdu.long_meaning: جاہدہ نام کا مطلب ہے محنت کرنا، جدوجہد کرنا، اللہ کی راہ میں تھکاوٹ کو برداشت کرنا، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جہید تعریف کرتا ہے ایک ایسی شخصیت کو جو ہمیشہ محنت اور جدوجہد کے ساتھ اللہ کی رضا حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کرتی ہے

in_english.name: Jahida
in_english.meaning: Jahida means striving in the way of Allah, effort in good deeds
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jahida is derived from the Arabic root 'jahada', which means to strive or to make an effort. In Islamic tradition, Jahida refers to someone who strives in the way of Allah, exerting effort in performing good deeds and pleasing Him. This name is mentioned in the Quran, Surah Al-Furqan, verse 52: 'And those who strive in Our cause, We shall certainly guide them on Our paths.' Jahida symbolizes a person with strong determination, perseverance, and spiritual dedication
